name: Wacom Intuos CTL-4100K (Small/Black)
summary: Wacom Intuos CTL-4100K (Small/Black) - Graphic Tablets - Explore new ways to get creative Wacom Intuos is designed for those who are drawing, painting and photo-editing for the first time. The 4k pressure-sensitive pen gives you advanced pen performance a
description_html:
Wacom Intuos is designed for those who are drawing, painting and photo-editing for the first time. The 4k pressure-sensitive pen gives you advanced pen performance and realistic pen-on-paper feel. Bring your ideas to life with free software. Wacom Intuos is all you need to get creative digitally.

Battery-free pen

With its 4096 pressure levels and EMR technology, the pen delivers both precision and control

Compact and Stylish

Super slim and compact pen tablet with large active drawing area so you have more room to create

Simple setup

Connect to your computer via USB, install the driver, register & start creating in no time

Shortcut Keys

Four customizable ExpressKeys put your favorite keyboard shortcuts at the press of a button

Create what you want, the way you want

A graphics tablet designed entirely around your passion, the Wacom Intuos gives you all the tools you need to enhance your creativity. The first thing you’ll experience when using Wacom Intuos is how natural it feels. The 4k pressure-sensitive pen, designed to suit both left- and right-handed users, has an ergonomic design for ease-of-use and comfort. Whether you love to draw manga art, paint digital watercolors or retouch your photos, download free creative software to suit your style.

 *This model doesn't support Bluetooth connectivity. 

Windows® 7 or later (excluding Windows 10 S; latest service pack/build), OS X 10.11 or later (latest update)

 

free software included:

Wacom provides you with free creative software and offers. Register and download the free software here that comes with your product. *Software bundles differ by model and region

You can choose 1 of 2 :

Corel Painter Essentials 8 (90-day license)

Corel AfterShot  (90-day license)

description_html_ar:
استمتع بالرسم على جرافيك تابلت Wacom Intuos بمساحة 6x3.7 مع 4 مفاتيح اختصار يمكنك تخصيصهم وفقاً لراحتك. 

 

تحكم أكثر في الرسم

ارسم بدقة مع قلم لا يحتاج إلى بطارية ويعمل بتقنية الـ EMR يدعم 4096 من حساسية الضغط كما يجعلك ترسم باحساس الرسم على الورق 

 

اتصال سهل :

قم بالاتصال بجهاز الكمبيوتر الخاص بك عبر USB ، وقم بتثبيت برنامج التشغيل ، والتسجيل وابدأ في الرسم 

-يمكنك توصيله بالهاتف (أندرويد 6.0  أو أعلى )

 

 * لا يدعم هذا الطراز اتصال Bluetooth.

Windows® 7 أو أحدث (excluding Windows 10 S; latest service pack/build), OS X 10.11 أو أحدث (أخر تحديث)

 

- يمكنك تحميل برنامج بشكل مجاني من البرامج الآتية : 

Corel Painter Essentials 8 ( 3 شهور )

Corel AfterShot ( 3 شهور )

*قد تختلف البرامج من دولة إلى أخرى

لتنزيل البرنامج، قم بتسجيل الدخول إلى Wacom ببياناتك الشخصية، وسجل الـ Intuos الخاص بك.

*يعتمد توافق البرامج على نظام التشغيل الخاص بجهازك.
